title: Independent-ledger transfer grant creation
description: Trusted append-only authorization event written before approval acknowledgement. It reserves a never-reused grant ID and binds the immutable grant scope and authenticated A/B decision set across application or broker PITR. It is not a browser or worker payload.

grant_id.description: Globally unique, server-generated ID. A durable global grant-ID uniqueness index in the independent ledger rejects reuse across tenants, jobs, revisions, rollback, and restore; random UUID generation alone is insufficient. Only the same approval transaction may retry idempotently with identical event binding.

approval_ref.description: Opaque reference to the authenticated A-export and B-template decision set named by the immutable job policy grant.

approval_idempotency_ref.description: Server-generated identity of the exact approval transaction. It permits only an identical retry after an uncertain append or recoverable policy commit failure.

approved_at.description: Time the second required decision completed; matches the immutable grant's approved_at and is checked against both decisions in approval_decisions_sha256. It is recorded after approval and therefore is not part of the scope the two decisions sign.

destination_template_sha256.description: Digest of the pinned, reviewed destination template bytes, including its exact declarative upstream argument expression and renderer artifact version/digest.

grant_scope_sha256.description: Digest of v1 canonical UTF-8 JSON containing tenant_id, job_id, policy_version, the immutable grant authorization fields (including grant_id, tool, limits, and expiry but excluding post-decision approval_ref and approved_at), exact source/destination partition selectors, destination template digest, and all source extractor/verifier and destination renderer artifact version/digest bindings. The event separately binds approval_ref and approved_at to its decision-set hash. V1 sorts object keys lexicographically, uses compact comma/colon separators and unescaped Unicode, and rejects duplicate keys or non-finite numbers.

approval_decisions_sha256.description: Digest of the authenticated, tamper-evident A-export/declassification and B-template/resource acceptance decision set bound to grant_scope_sha256, using the same v1 canonical JSON rule. Runtime verifies both decisions' signatures or equivalent proof, actor authorities, scope, and times.
